title: sse-streaming-partial-json-delimiter-token-ordering-fix
author: Aisha Patel
description: Fixes multiple interrelated issues in the SSE streaming path that were causing partial JSON payloads to be emitted in incorrect delimiter/token order under high-concurrency conditions. Motivation: customers reported intermittent JSON parse errors and partial-object reordering when using the OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoint; investigation indicated a race between chunk framing, event delimiter emission, and tokenization boundaries introduced by batching. This PR addresses three root causes: 1) incorrect handling of boundary tokens when a token spans two internal chunks (fix: carry-over buffer and explicit token-boundary marker), 2) event delimiter emission happening before stream finalization (fix: reorder emitter to flush full JSON object then delimiter), 3) occasional reordering of partial JSON fields due to concurrent writes to the SSE buffer (fix: single-writer flush + per-request sequencing). Changes include runtime-level fixes, unit and integration tests, and an isolated e2e harness to reproduce the race. Checklist: updated unit tests; added integration test for partial-json streaming; added e2e reproducer and CI job; documented behavior in streaming.md; added Linear link. Risk: medium (touches hot path and buffer management) but gated behind feature-flag and validated across Dedicated and Hosted in staging; rollout plan uses canary on 5% traffic then 25% then 100%.
